description: Deterministic FINAL ICP qualification rules. Consumes the preliminary ICP output (data/icp/icp_qualified.json) and the website enrichment evidence output (data/enrichment/website_enrichment.json), joined by master_id. Status is decided entirely by evidence-gate rules (geography, hard exclusions, residential-only, direct-service evidence thresholds) BEFORE any score/tier is computed -- score/tier can never promote a record past what the status rules already decided. No AI/LLM, no network calls, no paid APIs.

website_hard_exclusion_signals.description: New, website-evidence-based hard exclusions beyond what preliminary ICP already catches from name/category text alone. A record is excluded if its homepage title/description matches a manufacturer/distributor/supply/parts-counter/association/directory/media pattern AND it has zero direct_service matches in hvac_direct_categories or bucket2_service_categories (i.e. all commercial-category evidence, if any, is incidental).

rating_reviews.description: review_count_at_least_50 REPLACES review_count_at_least_10's point, it does not stack -- total capped at 2.

notes: n_hvac == 0 can never produce final_icp_status='qualified' on any website-confirmed path, regardless of score, vertical breadth, rating, or review_count.
The website-unavailable fallback (preliminary_icp_only) is the ONLY qualification path that does not require hvac_direct_categories evidence, because no website evidence exists to evaluate.
Score and tier are computed strictly after status is finalized and never feed back into status.
Fallback-qualified records are capped at tier B.
